volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

drive.tooltip: Input gain into the tube grid (0...4). Higher Drive pushes harder into the load-line curve.

bias.tooltip: Grid bias / operating point (-1...+1). Shifts where the transfer curve sits.

load.tooltip: Blends precomputed plate load lines (light to heavy). No same-sample feedback iteration.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Affects Trisaw, Analog Square (same-direction peaks), Trisaw Center (opposing peaks toward saw), Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param r

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only — type large values for gain past unity (domain not hard-clamped).

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

offset.tooltip: Bias. Off/On choices by default. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

offset.tooltip: Bias. Off/On choices by default. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: MIDI offset in octaves before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: MIDI offset in semitones before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Fine MIDI offset in cents before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. LP / HP use LPF / HPF. BP is HP→LP in series (no cutoff swap — HPF above LPF collapses the band).

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). In BP, raising this past LPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). In BP, lowering this past HPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the HPF/LPF interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Raise domain for large CV into ƒ (e.g. filter → frequency).

upShape.tooltip: Rising glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

downShape.tooltip: Falling glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

upTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a higher target from the current value (any amplitude — Hz, CV, audio). 0 = instant.

downTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a lower target from the current value (any amplitude). 0 = instant.

bias.tooltip: Offset added before slew (0…1). Hidden by default — show it to step the target by hand.

frequency.tooltip: AM Index Bias (carrier Hz). f = Speed × (1 + sine × Top Morph).

morph.tooltip: AM Index (normalized). Scales the PolyBLEP sine into Speed. 0 = constant Speed. 1 = Speed × (1 + sine). Spawn 0…1.

sideMorph.tooltip: Adds sine × Side Morph to phase (cycles). 0 = no phase wobble. Breadboard: Sine → attenuverter → Phase.

randomFreq.tooltip: S&H random multiplier on LFO increment (VibratoGenerator randomFreqMult).

randomAmp.tooltip: S&H random multiplier on LFO amplitude (VibratoGenerator randomAmpMult).

delayMode.tooltip: Start: delay Attack unless depth is already releasing (a gate during release goes straight to Attack). Gate close starts Release immediately. StartEnd: same attack rule, and also delay Release when the gate closes. Gate: delay the entire gate, including gate-off; Attack and Release follow that delayed gate.

delay.tooltip: Hold before Attack after Gate rises. 0 = no delay. No Gate cable skips straight to sustain (Attack does not run).

attack.tooltip: Exponential depth fade-in time when Gate goes high. 0 = instant snap. Unpatched Gate stays at full depth.

release.tooltip: Exponential depth fade-out time when Gate goes low. 0 = instant snap.

isIdleRelease.tooltip: Release time used instead of Release while the isIdle input is true (a cable is plugged and that signal's amplitude is at or below Planck). No cable: this param does nothing. 0 = instant snap.

attackShape.tooltip: Attack curve: Log starts slow and finishes fast; Lin rises linearly; Exp keeps the existing exponential rise. Hidden — enable from the parameter visibility menu.

releaseShape.tooltip: Release curve: Log starts slow and finishes fast; Lin falls linearly; Exp keeps the existing exponential fall.
